"""Generate URL-safe slugs from titles."""

import re

_MAX_LENGTH = 40
_ALLOWED = re.compile(r'[^a-z0-9 -]')
_SEPARATORS = re.compile(r'[ -]+')


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Return a slug for *title* following the project rules."""
    slug = title.lower().replace('&', ' and ')
    slug = _ALLOWED.sub('', slug)
    slug = _SEPARATORS.sub('-', slug).strip('-')
    return slug[:_MAX_LENGTH].rstrip('-')
